title: Ordinary-world firearms: existing iron nuggets as consumable ammunition
assumptions: 2026-11-01: scenario assumptions, not telemetry: 1/5/20 participating players, 1/2/4 active hours per day, 100/500/2500 expended rounds per active hour.
Raw guns start empty, one ordinary iron nugget loads one round. Event ammo never loads ordinary guns. No new money, XP, loot or reward payout is introduced.
Iron nuggets can come from existing inventories/farms; shop purchase is optional, not an assumed new money sink. Configured EconomyShopGUI buy 2.22 vault/nugget, sell -1, is unverified live.
Existing EconomyShopGUI SELL remains in the current scenario; planned SELL-to-contract transition is future and is not counted as active replacement income.

New ranged access can change manual mob-kill efficiency. Existing native armour, hurt immunity, reward eligibility and protection cancellation remain; the incremental kill/reward rate is unknown and not represented as measured zero.

flows.basis: Items consumed from existing inventory into persistent weapon magazines; not money issuance or a currency exchange. Daily use scenarios are assumptions.
